*Ecology & Evolution / Conservation / Science*

I’m a trained field ecologist, focused on conservation, sustainable farming,
science education, and science communication. I graduated with a B.S. & M.S.
in Biology, with a Minor in Chemistry, from [IISER Trivandrum](https://www.iisertvm.ac.in/), where
I worked with [Prof. Hema Somanathan](https://www.iisertvm.ac.in/faculty/hsomanathan)
and the [BEE Lab](https://faculty.iisertvm.ac.in/beelab/). I took up field
research in the western ghats (Bhimashankar) for an year, after which I pursued
a Ph.D. at the [TrEE Lab](treelab.wixsite.com/tree/), under the supervision of
[Dr. Vinita Gowda](https://bio.iiserb.ac.in/Home/faculty_details/1383), at [IISER Bhopal](https://www.iiserb.ac.in/).
After my Ph.D., I founded the [Saryan Vigyan Foundation](http://saryanfoundation.org/)
to pursue fundamental scientific research and translate it into sustainable living
in the Kinnaur district and Himachal Pradesh
broadly. I enable frugal science as a Scientific Consultant to the Deep Tech
Innovation Centre, Graphic Era University and [SoftCircuits Labs](https://www.softcircuits.in/).

I’m always interested in working with students and collaborators, especially
tribals. Reach out to me if you’re interested in field
ecology, conservation, natural farming, plant-animal (including human) interaction,
eco-hydro-geology, and science communication, science education. Please see my research
page for a detailed look at my work.

Currently, I’m establishing Saryan Vatika, a high altitude nature reserve (3100 m above mean sea level) to
study and preserve endangered plant species. You could watch this [short documentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6j9WyAMmsX8)
featuring me and my work to get a better understanding of why I do what I do.
